card.name: Mixed words in fixed phrases
card.fires_on: Scattered single words at points where a stock phrase continues, such as 'and' after 'monitored appropriately' or 'expected' after 'unless the benefits are'. Also the start of 'Echoing' and 'Suggested citation'.

modes.label: Warning phrase links
modes.description: A linking word or verb inside a standard label warning sentence.
modes.example: should be monitored appropriately<< and>> observed closely for clinical worsening, suicid

modes.label: Citation or web text
modes.description: A word or full stop inside a reference line or a web article phrase.

card.plain: It fires on a mix of unrelated words that sit inside set phrases, so no single meaning stands out.
